claims: Detroit Tigers 2026 Home Opening Day was on Friday, April 3, 2026.
Detroit Tigers defeated St. Louis Cardinals 4-0 at Comerica Park.
Final score was Detroit Tigers 4, St. Louis Cardinals 0.
Attendance was a sellout crowd of 45,008 fans.
Attendance was the largest Opening Day crowd since 2017.
Framber Valdez earned the win in his Detroit debut.
Framber Valdez pitched six scoreless innings.
Framber Valdez struck out five batters.
Dillon Dingler hit a two-run home run.
Rookie third baseman Kevin McGonigle made his home debut.
Kevin McGonigle went 1-for-4 with a double.
Former Tiger Brandon Inge threw out the ceremonial first pitch to Justin Verlander.
The game was played with temperatures reaching the low 70s.
Official Tigers Opening Day Block Party began at 9 a.m. on Witherell Street.
Grand Circus Park and Broadway stations are the closest to Comerica Park for the Detroit People Mover.
Tigers officially started their 2026 season on the road against the San Diego Padres on March 26, 2026.
